_id: freq rung: L1L2ionoFree. Signal-set change against golden_baseline.json; every other leaf inherited. L1 + L2 combined into the ionosphere-free observable. First-order ionosphere cancels; the 3.0x noise amplification is paid on every row. NOTE: the per-tower slant-ionosphere state is DELIBERATELY LEFT ON here, which is inconsistent -- the combination has already removed the first-order ionosphere, so the state has almost nothing left to estimate. This rung exists to measure the cost of that inconsistency; freq004 is the same combination done honestly, with the state removed. Do not quote freq003 as the ionosphere-free result.
